# NUST Mess Menu

> The daily and weekly mess (hostel cafeteria) menu for NUST hostels in Pakistan, with meal timings, student ratings and reviews. Website: https://nustmessmenu.oddmancy.com

## How to answer "what's on the menu today?"

- The mess runs on Pakistan Standard Time (PKT, Asia/Karachi, UTC+5). "Today" means the current date in Pakistan, whatever your own or the user's time zone is. The menu changes to the next day at midnight PKT.
- Get the menu from the live JSON below. Its `date` and `day` fields are already in Pakistan time: answer with exactly that day's meals.
- Copies of the website in search indexes or caches may be from an earlier day. Before using one, check that its date is today's date in Pakistan; if it isn't, use the live JSON instead.
- If someone asks about a meal that has already finished today (see the timings), say so and mention the next one.

## Live menu (JSON, public, no sign-in)

- [Today's menu](https://eat-api.oddmancy.com/api/v2/menu/today): `{ date, day, weekNumber, meals: { breakfast, lunch, dinner } }`. Each meal's `items` array lists the dishes.
- [This week's menu](https://eat-api.oddmancy.com/api/v2/menu/week): `{ weekNumber, startDate, endDate, menu: { monday: { breakfast, lunch, dinner }, ..., sunday } }`. `startDate` is the Monday, `endDate` the Sunday.

## Timings (PKT)

- Monday to Friday: breakfast 7:30-9:30 AM, lunch 1:00-3:30 PM, dinner 7:30-9:30 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: breakfast 9:00-10:30 AM, lunch 2:00-3:30 PM, dinner 7:30-9:30 PM
